title: 7. Digital Signatures
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L08: Cryptography 2 (Asymmetric, PKI, TLS, Signatures): 7. Digital Signatures .

items: Encrypt digest with signer's private key → signature
Receiver decrypts signature with signer's public key → revealed digest
RSA-PSS — preferred over PKCS#1 v1.5 (provably secure padding)
ECDSA (P-256) — fast, but careful with nonce reuse

blocks.text: Sony's ECDSA implementation reused the nonce. fail0verflow group recovered the master signing key with simple linear algebra. ECDSA nonce reuse = total private key leak.
Ed25519 fixes this category of bug by deriving the nonce deterministically from key + message.
